title: Wreath-Product B_M = S_2 wr S_M Sector Decomposition and Binomial Singlet Sufficiency
claims: Under B_M = S_2 wr S_M on 2M qubits, the Hilbert space decomposes into M+1 singlet-count sectors of dimension C(M, k) * 3^{M-k} summing to 4^M.

Under intra-pair singlet/triplet measurement, the singlet count K_sing ~ Binomial(M, (1 - gamma^2 cos(theta_0))/2), whereas coherent Sym^{2M}(C^2) projection strictly dominates when all 2M copies share the same signed phase.
